generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Kppp portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end. EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Conditional tender will not be considered and will be liable for Rejection.
The employer reserves the right to accept any tender and to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason.
The contractor has to compete the bid (quote the rates) for all schedule B items of the works mentioned. Sub-Leasing/G.P.A of Work is prohibited.Tender application amount will not be refundable.

The Contractor shall pay the Earnest Money Deposit EMD & Tender Transaction fee in the Kppp portal using any of the following payment modes Credit card, Debit card, Net banking, Remittance at the bank counter, NEFT/RTGS.

The tenderer shall scan and upload all the original documents required for this bid to the Kppp portal. The uploaded documents should be clear (Visible), unclear documents will be rejected. The original documents shall be produced at the time of physical verification.
One percent of the bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted towards cess as a labor welfare fund.

Original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of the Tender process, as and when sought for. Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualification. Work done certificates should have all the CR no, work order issuing date, work completion date and year. All documents to be furnished are to be counter signed by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an executive in-charge or equivalent.

The contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority, before execution. Transportation charges from the site of work to Q.C. Lab of all the samples collected for testing should borne by the contractor himself.

Price adjustment clause will not be applicable as per prevailing government order and only star rates are applicable. The intending bidder firm/ company are advised to visit the work site before submission of tenders.
Omission and typographical errors which are in the opinion of the executive Engineer will not be a ground for claims of extra payment.
IT, GST and others taxes will be deducted as per the prevailing Government Order. GST & EPF registration certificate from competent authority.
The tender is invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-4 and shall abide for the conditions contained in Standard tender Bid Document KW-4.

Executive engineer reserves the right to accept or reject any tender and to cancel the tender process and reject all tenders at any time prior to award of contract, without there by incurring any liability to the affected tenderer or tenderers or any obligation to inform the affected tenderer or tenderers of the grounds for the employers action.

The contractor must upload existing commitment of the ongoing works in hand for the calculation of tender capacity. Tenderers shall provide the requested information accurately and in sufficient detail in section 3.
Restrictions on Public Procurement from Bidders of certain countries as per Government order No.FD 455 Exp-12 2020 Bangalore dated: 01.04.2023
Item for which 0.00 rates entered will not be paid for by the employer when executed and shall be deemed covered by the other rates & prices in the bill of quantities.
The Defects Liability Period is 365 Days after the completion of work.
Royalty Charges will be applicable as per Prevailing G.O at the time of payment
Bidder shall quote Rates without adding GST

All documents enclosed should be attested by Gazetted officer or Government Notary, otherwise the bids are liable for disqualification. Original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of the Tender process, as and when sought for. Failure to produce original documents will lead to disqualification. Work done certificates should have all the CR no, work order issuing date, work completion date and year. All documents to be furnished are to be counter signed by the employer in charge, not below the rank of an executive in-charge or equivalent.

The contractor should obtain the Material Dispatch Permit for stone, aggregates, sand and Murom etc will be used in the construction work from the Mines and Geology department at the time of execution and same should be submitted along with the work bill, then for such work bills no Royalty will be deducted. If the contractor failed to submit the Material Dispatch Permit along with the work bill Five times Royalty will be deducted from the work bill as per KMMCR 2016 amendment rule 44(4) and the circular vide No.Ga.Bhu.E/DCB/DCB/Takte/2019-20/4497 Dated: 12/12/2019 by Mines and Geology department.
The Rate of Concrete Items are Inclusive of Formwork, Shuttering, Scaffolding and Centering Works

technicalCriterionList.description: ITT 3.2 C To qualify for award of this contract,each Tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period 2021-22 TO 2025-26) (c) Executed in any one year (for a continuous period of 12 months), the following minimum quantities of work: 1-Earthwork including excavation, embankment etc.- 21296.00 Cum, 2- Cement Concrete (RCC/PCC)- 475.00 Cum, 3- Reinforcement steel for RCC structures-6.74 Tonne, 4- Pitching / Revetment -1836.00 Sqm

ITT 3.2 B.To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years Period (2021-22 TO 2025-26) B) Satisfactory completion as a prime contractor for at least one similar work such as Construction of New Tank/Lakes/Percolation tanks, Improvements/ Rejuvenation to tanks/lakes works of value not less than Rs. 60.49 Lakhs (Upload scan copy of work done Certificate report issued by the employer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division.)

ITT 3.2 A.To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years Period (2021-22 TO 2025-26) A) Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (In all classes of Civil Engineering Construction works) of Rs 241.95 Lakhs. itemList.itemCode: Item No.2.5(ii)a Pg No.9 PWD CSR-2023-24 (Vol-3)
itemList.description: Clearing and grubbing road land including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. (ii )By mechanical means using Dozer (a)In area of light jungle.and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

itemList.itemCode: Item No 3.27 Pg No. 142 MI&GWD CSR-2023-24(Vol-4)
itemList.description: Excavating grip trenches of specified size in all kinds of soil in existing bund for abutting fresh embankment to strengthen the existing bund including disposing off the excavated soil in in specified dump area & all necessary works as directed and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

itemList.itemCode: Item No 3.15 Pg No.140 MI&GWD CSR-2023-24 Vol-4
itemList.description: Providing new embankment to slopes of the existing bund to strength the existing bund using soil from approved borrow area in layers of 200 to 250 mm and compacting each layer manually to meet required density including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, picking previous layer, spreading soil in layer, breaking clods, watering, & all necessary works as directed and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

itemList.itemCode: Item No 3.2 Pg No.139 MI&GWD CSR-2023-24 (Vol-4)
itemList.description: Removing disturbed rough / size stone revetment 300 mm thick with 150 mm thick 40 mm down aggregate backing and resetting the same using the available stones and fresh aggregate from quarry including handpacking, wedging, finishing & all necessary works as directed and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

itemList.itemCode: Item No 1.6 Pg No.129 MI&GWD CSR-2023-24 (Vol-4)
itemList.description: Providing and constructing 450 mm thick hand packed rough stone revetment consisting of 300 mm thick rough stones with 400 to 450 mm long through stones at 1.5 m c / c over a backing of 150 mm thick 40 mm down graded coarse aggregate layer including cost of all materials machinery, labour, laying to specified slope, wedging with chips, finishing & all necessary works as directed and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

itemList.itemCode: Item No 1.12 Pg No.130 MI&GWD CSR-2023-24 (Vol-4)
itemList.description: Providing and laying insitu vibrated M-20 ( 28 days cube compressive strength not less than 20 N / sq mm ) grade cement concrete using 20 mm down size approved, clean, hard, graded aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, centering, formwork and scafolding and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications for check dam /pickups /irrigation tanks/waste weir/ sluice, sluice canal and other allied works like abutments/wing walls/returns/cutoff walls works & all necessary works as directed and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

itemList.itemCode: Item No 2.11(h) Pg No.18 PWD CSR-2023-24(Vol-1)
itemList.description: Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technial specification. e.All other type of structures and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

Spec. No. As directed by Engineer in Charge & MoRTH specification 804 and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

itemList.itemCode: Item No 3.12 Pg No.140 MI&GWD CSR-2023-24 VOL-4
itemList.description: De-silting of tank bed /Feeder Channel/Canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and loading the same to transport vehicle ( excluding cost of transportation ) including cost of all machinery, labour & all necessary works as directed and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

itemList.itemCode: Item No.1.14.1 Pg No. 8 CSR For 2023 - 24 PWD Vol-
itemList.description: Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including Cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work.In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m.and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.

itemList.description: Providing and laying Polished Sadarahalli Grey Granite stone flooring in required design and patterns, in linear as well as curvilinear portions of the building all complete as per the architectural drawings with 20 mm thick stone slab over 20 mm (average) thick base of cement mortar 1:4 (1 cement : 4 coarse sand) laid and jointed with cement slurry and pointing with white cement slurry admixed with pigment of matching shade including rubbing , curing and polishing etc. and Complete with all lead and lifts, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work.
